name: ejercicio 4 - contextos - artifacts

on:
    push:

jobs:
    build:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - name: Checkout
              uses: actions/checkout@v4

            - name: setup node
              uses: actions/setup-node@v4

            - name: Install
              run: npm ci

            - name: Build
              run: npm run build

            - name: Upload build
              uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
              with:
                name: build
                path: dist/
